title: rhus javanica var. chinensis
intro: Rhus javanica var. chinensis, commonly known as the Chinese sumac or Rhus chinensis, is a species of flowering plant in the Anacardiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Rhus javanica var. chinensis include anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
